fullBackup.title: Full backup & restore
fullBackup.intro: A full backup captures the database, revision history, account records and all managed media, producing a consistent snapshot with a checksum manifest. Restoring creates a new container with no external network and never overwrites the current site.
fullBackup.generateHint: Create a full backup from a terminal in the project:
fullBackup.verifyHint: Verify and restore in isolation using the generated backup directory:
fullBackup.afterRestore: Restoring revokes the sign-in grants contained in the backup, and existing pages must be reloaded before changing data. Connection settings are saved in the restore directory; the app connection is not switched automatically. See docs/backup-and-recovery.md in the project for the full steps.

export.title: Export content package
export.scope: Used to move posts, flashes, moments, gallery, projects, links, image prompts, comments, guestbook messages, taxonomy and the current site profile. Posts, gallery works, projects, links and prompts are imported as drafts; guestbook messages are imported as pending, with hidden and deleted states preserved.
export.excluded: Content packages exclude accounts, sign-in credentials, visitor control tokens, likes, reactions, revision history and interaction dedup records. Use the maintenance workflow for a full database and media restore.
export.withMedia: The file includes managed image bytes; external images keep their original URLs.
export.withoutMedia: Only the media manifest is included; importing requires the assets to already exist or the image files to be restored separately.

import.title: Import content
import.formats: Accepts v1–v14 JSON content packages generated by this project, up to 50MB. v14 keeps the search engine indexing setting, v13 keeps flash comment moderation states, v12 keeps navigation, footer links, the daily quote and ICP filing info, v11 keeps platform subscription fees and price history, v10 keeps image prompts, and v9 keeps content relations and media captions. External image URLs are not downloaded into the media library. The package and its managed image references are validated before you confirm the import.
import.guestbookNote: Imported guestbook messages are never published or pinned automatically. Deleted messages are kept as invisible reference records; review the content and authors before approving.
import.strategySkip: Skip identical content; links are matched by canonical URL
import.strategyCopy: Create new draft copies of everything
import.includeSettings: Also import the site profile, gear notes, link guidelines and comment moderation settings
import.duplicateRule: Duplicate detection ignores publish status and interaction counts. Taxonomy follows this site's historical naming rules. New copies start their views and likes from zero, and links in the body are kept as-is, so review them before publishing.
import.linkRule: When skipping, links are matched by canonical site URL; when copying, a new draft is created even if the URL matches, keeping its featured flag and order. Path case, trailing slashes, query order and fragments are never rewritten; check existing public records before publishing a draft with the same URL.

overview.rulesUnanswered: Awaiting reply only counts visible top-level visitor comments on public posts and public, undeleted top-level visitor guestbook messages. A public direct reply from the author removes an item; hiding or deleting that reply counts it again.
overview.rulesPending: Pending post comments include every pending comment still manageable in the admin. Moment comments and guestbook messages exclude soft-deleted items, and moment comments also exclude deleted moments. Withdrawn or hidden parent content isn't counted as awaiting reply.
overview.rulesOther: Moments and flashes have no direct reply relationship, so they aren't counted as awaiting reply; flashes have no moderation status. Read or unread notifications don't affect these to-dos.

overview.draftsNote: Totals exclude soft-deleted items. Archived and withdrawn items aren't drafts, and archived flashes don't count as drafts even if they keep a draft flag.
